subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Of Wolves and Stags
email_body:
Hi Ria,

It is wonderful to see Of Wolves and Stags launch with Inked in Gray Press, with the rest of the Crystalline Hearts trilogy lined up in Of Snakes and Blossoms and Of Foxes and Blades. Dalia's story as a living weapon who is feared by some and used by others is a striking premise.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

With a trilogy underway and a vivid world of elves, resistance fighters and living weapons, a short trailer or a few reels for Of Wolves and Stags is something we can produce from start to finish, if that is something you have been considering. It is entirely optional and can be added alongside the Spotlight whenever the timing suits you.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Of Wolves and Stags best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
